mapper.select: SELECT B.BNO,B.BNAME,B.BIMG,MB.MBNO,MB.OLNO,MB.MBSTART,MB.MBEND,TRUNC(MB.MBEND) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DAYSLEFT FROM MEMBER_BOOKS MB LEFT JOIN BOOK B ON MB.BNO = B.BNO WHERE MB.MNO = #{mno} AND MB.MBSTATUS = '대여중' ORDER BY MB.OLNO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_BOOKS SET MBEND = MBEND + #{extendDays}, MBEXTENSION = MBEXTENSION + 1 WHERE MBNO=#{mbno}
